app_store.name: IKnowMyMoney Expense Tracker
app_store.subtitle: Private Offline Budget Tool
app_store.promotional_text: Track daily spending offline with zero tracking. Manage accounts, set budgets, view charts, and export CSV reports with complete data privacy.
app_store.whats_new: What's New in v1.1.0: Transaction tags, trip budget tracking, account transaction ledger, multi-line notes, and 1-tap Today/Yesterday date recording.
app_store.description:
IKnowMyMoney is a fast, completely offline personal finance tracker designed to give you clarity over your money without compromising your privacy.

All your transactions, accounts, and budgets stay 100% on your device inside local SQLite storage. No account creation required, no third-party servers, and zero ads.

KEY FEATURES:

• FAST TRANSACTION LOGGING
Log expenses, income, or transfers in seconds with an intuitive keypad, multi-line notes, and flexible date/time recording with 1-tap Today/Yesterday presets.

• TRANSACTION TAGS & TRIP BUDGETS
Tag transactions with multiple labels (e.g. "LV Trip", "Costco", "Me") to track vacation spending, recurring bills, or family members with dedicated target progress bars.

• MULTI-ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT & LEDGERS
Track Cash, Checking accounts, Credit Cards, and Savings in one place. Tap any account to inspect its real-time calculated balance and complete transaction history.

• SMART CATEGORY BUDGETS & HISTORY
Set monthly spending limits for categories and track your progress with clear color-coded indicators. Browse past months to review historical budget performance.

• VISUAL SPENDING ANALYTICS
Understand your cash flow with interactive category breakdowns, monthly comparisons, and distribution charts.

• LOCAL BACKUP & EXPORT
Export database snapshots directly to your device storage, or generate clean CSV reports for tax records or spreadsheet analysis.

• PRIVACY GUARANTEE
Your financial records belong solely to you. IKnowMyMoney never uploads or tracks your data.
